translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Guyau iyoumatila baisa Samwela
Wa yam makwaisina, avai tuta monagwadi Samwela iuwotetila baisa Yaubada metoya ola vakeda Ilai, mimilisi wala biga leima metoya baisa Guyau, deli kilisala metoya baisa matauna gala ibawa.
E Ilai baisa tuta katitaikina bikau matala. E bogi kwaitala matauna immasisi matabudona paila titoulela,
e Samwela immasisi matabudona Bomikikila ambaisa Kabutu Didawogala
eisisu. Igau wala visiga e kaitapa eilululu
wala.
E Guyau idou kawala, “Samwela! Samwelʹo!” E Samwela ivitakauloki, kawala, “Wo toboma!”
deli isakaula baisa Ilai ikaibiga, kawala, “Lokudouwaigu e lamakaiam.” Mitaga Ilai ivitakauloki, kawala, “Gala adouwaim. Kula kukwenu.” Mapaila Samwela ila ikenu okabala.

Guyau idouvau Samwela. Samwela gala inikoli baisa Guyau eidoudou, paila Guyau gala kwaitala tuta eibigitoni matauna. Mapaila itokaia ilokaia Ilai ikaibiga, kawala, “Lokudouwaigu e lamakaiam.” Mitaga Ilai ivitakauloki, kawala, “Latugu, gala adouwaim. Kula kukwenu.”
Guyau idou Samwela sivitolula. Itokaia ilokaia Ilai ikaibiga, “Lokudouwaigu e lamakaiam.” E mauula Ilai bogwa eitapuloki nanola baisa Guyau ididou monagwadi,
mapaila ikaibiga baisa matauna, kawala, “Kula kukwenu. E kidamwa bidouwaim tuvaila, bukukwaibiga kawam, ‘Mwa! Guyau kulivala! Yeigu m towotetila laninakaigila.’” Mapaila Samwela ila ikenu okabala.
Guyau ima itowa baisa, deli idou makawala bogwa eivigibogwi, “Samwela! Samwelʹo!” E Samwela ivitakauloki kawala, “Kulivala. Yeigu m towotetila laninakaigila.”
Guyau ilivala baisa matauna kawala, “Avai yam wala yeigu bavagi kwaitala vavagi baisa mina Isireli saina kabokokola, e availa availa bilagaisi bogwa biyowa luposi.
Wa yam makwaina bavagi komwaidona ulo vitukokola baisa Ilai litula, metoya okala vitouula bila okala vigimkovila.
Bogwa lalukibogwi matauna mwada yeigu bamipuki veyala tuta gala biwokuva, paila litula eikoulovaigusi. Ilai bogwa inikoli matausina eiuvagaisi makawala mitaga gala ibuyoyu matausina.
Mapaila lakamituli baisa Ilai veyala kidamwa gala avai lula kaina avai semakavi bikosuweu makwaina mitugaga.”
Samwela ikanukwenu okabala tatoula iyambwabwaila, e itokaia iulaim yoyula la bwala Guyau. Ikokola biluki Ilai paila makwaina kilisala.
E Ilai idou matauna, kawala, “Latugʹo, Samwela!” E Samwela ivitakauloki, kawala, “Wo, toboma!”
Ilai ikatupoi, kawala, “Avaka Guyau eilukwaim? Taga bukukwatupwani avaka baisa yeigu. Yaubada bimipukwaim sainela kidamwa gala bukulukwaigu komwaidona vavagi makwaisina eilukwaim.”
Mapaila Samwela iluki vavagi komwaidona; gala kwaitala vavagi ikatupwani. Ilai ikaibiga, kawala, “Matauna goli Guyau. Matauna bivagi wala avai vavagi bibudoki nanola.”
Samwela bogwa eitoveka, e Guyau tuta komwaidona eisikaili matauna, e Guyau eivigaki komwaidona makwaisina eiluki Samwela gala wala bisala.
Mapaila mina Isireli komwaidona, metoya pilatala bila piliyuwela, bogwa einikolaisi Samwela matauna taitala Guyau la tovitoubobuta.

Guyau iyovigasi wala iyoumatila titoulela mapilana Sailo, baisa goli eiviloubusi baisa Samwela, deli eibigatona deli matauna. Deli avai tuta Samwela bilivala e komwaidona mina Isireli bogwa binakaigalaisi.

footnotes.text: Kabutu Didawogala.Kugisi makasana Biga Kala Katumiki.
Makaina kaitapa ilululu wala bogi komwaidona olumoulela matabudona Bomikikila Sainela; kugisi Sun 27.20-21.
